output_directory.description: The directory to write the contents of the archive to.

force_overwrite.description: Always overwrite files when a file to be unpacked already exists on disk.

force_rename.description: Always rename files when a file to be unpacked already exists on disk.

force_skip.description: Always skip files when a file to be unpacked already exists on disk.

force_directory.description: Always create a containing directory for the contents of the unpacked archive.

no_directory.description: Never create a containing directory for the contents of the unpacked archive.

password.description: The password to use for decrypting protected archives.

encoding.description: The encoding to use for filenames in the archive, when it is not known.

password_encoding.description: The encoding to use for the password for the archive.

indexes.description: Specify files to list as indexes instead of filenames.

no_recursion.description: Do not attempt to extract archives contained in other archives.

copy_time.description: Copy the file modification time from the archive file to the containing directory.

forks.description: How to handle Mac OS resource forks: visible, hidden, or skip.

archive_path.description: The path to the archive file to process.

files_to_extract.description: List of specific files or wildcard patterns to extract. If empty, extracts all.
